description: Look up a saved NerdyData search definition by its UUID. Use this when the user shares a NerdyData report link (e.g. 'https://www.nerdydata.com/reports/shopify/<uuid>') or a search UUID. Returns the search name, its report URL, and the 'search' object with 'all' (AND), 'any' (OR), and 'none' (NOT) items, each including the technology name. Pass the returned 'search' object (keeping only 'type' and 'value' per item) to search_code or create_download to run it.

uuid.description: The saved search UUID, e.g. the last path segment of a /reports/<name>/<uuid> URL.

name: get_search_by_uuid
